description: JUnit test class for FineractExternalEventConfigCondition in Apache Fineract, testing different scenarios of the matches() method based on environment property 'fineract.events.external.partition-size'.

classes.name: FineractExternalEventConfigConditionTest
classes.description: Test class for FineractExternalEventConfigCondition, using Mockito to mock dependencies and JUnit 5 for testing different property configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the environment mock and sets it in conditionContext before each test.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenPartitionSizeIsNotBiggerThanLimit
methods.description: Tests that the matches() method returns false when 'fineract.events.external.partition-size' is below or equal to 25000.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenPartitionSizeIsBiggerThanLimit
methods.description: Tests that the matches() method returns true when 'fineract.events.external.partition-size' is above 25000.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenPartitionSizeIsNotPositive
methods.description: Tests that the matches() method returns true when 'fineract.events.external.partition-size' is zero or negative.
